profile.headline: SLSE @ DraftKings
profile.summary:
With over 14 years of experience in software engineering, I am passionate about building scalable, reliable, and secure systems that solve complex problems and deliver value to users and clients. I am currently a Senior Principal Software Engineer at Constant Contact, where I lead the engineering efforts on adopting Service Mesh, a cutting-edge technology that enables dynamic service discovery, routing, and security across a distributed microservices architecture.

As the engineering lead on Service Mesh, I collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders to design, implement, and test the Service Mesh solution, using technologies such as Java, Maven, Spring, Istio, and Kubernetes. I also mentor and coach other engineers on best practices, code quality, and performance optimization. In addition, I have contributed to several other projects at Constant Contact, such as the Common Identity Platform, the Syndication Platform, and the Core SaaS Services Infrastructure, developing business-critical, high-volume internal RESTful APIs.
